description: 51 tolled API lanes for AI agents: bounty boards, token safety screens, contract checks, market data, SEC filings, scam scans. Pay per call in USDC via x402 on Base or Solana. No accounts, no API keys — your wallet is your identity. Every lane answers one question before money moves: is this safe to touch?
identity: No accounts, no API keys. Your wallet is your identity.
name: TrollBridge
notes: Heuristic screens are labeled as such; not audits, legal, medical, or financial advice.

payment.policy: pay-or-nothing: unpaid requests return HTTP 402 with payment instructions; retry with the X-Payment header
